notes: The manual builds two separate circuits (sender and receiver); both are in one graph: mkr1/bb1/btn1 = sender, mkr2/bb2/led1/r1 = receiver.
The MKR WAN 1310 is not in the catalogue (only 1300), so a new type was created. Antenna is the catalogue lora-antenna, joined to the board's ANT (u.FL) connector.
The breadboard in the images shows rows f-j in the upper half and a-e in the lower half. Holes are named by row letter, so the upper half is bank 'b' (e.g. 5b.f).
Pushbutton: legs are at columns 5 and 7, row g. Which of its four pins are used is not visible, so 1.l and 2.r were assumed.
Sender: black wire from GND to column 5 row f. Yellow wire from pin 2 to column 7 row f. The firmware uses INPUT_PULLUP, so no resistor is needed.

Receiver: black wire from GND to column 6 row g. LED cathode is in column 6 and anode in column 8 (the bent leg). The resistor spans columns 8 to 11 on row g. The green wire goes from pin 2 to column 11 row f. The resistor value is not stated, so no value prop is set.
The two micro USB cables are not modelled because the catalogue usb-cable has no ports.
The black wire's board end is on the GND pin of the right-hand header, next to VCC.
